data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month; individual opt-in, not unanimity. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250-8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500-16k (25%). Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but cuts remaining stock8 and low-outcome next stock16. Even all18 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation.
